title: eat shit & die 225
author: bpatrick
body: A June update! Just under the wire.

comments.author: Jeff Tse
comments.text: Wow awesome man! Seriously good shit! I want to grow up and be a cartoonist like you!

comments.text:
Ever read The Magicians, by Lev Grossman?
This kind of reminds me of that.

comments.text: the graphics are just amazing. super cool blog. thanks for sharing.

comments.author: Maochael
comments.text: I loved it, but what does Jonny Paycheck think?

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text:
That’s what I’d like to know, Maochael. Thanks!
Ed Lu: No, I haven’t. Should I? Is it good?
Thanks Jeff Tse and popcultivation!

comments.author: Ed Lu
comments.text:
Hey bpatrick! The Magicians is really interesting. The basic question it answers is: what would happen if a fantasy-novel reader actually managed to get into a magic school?

As to whether it’s good, It’s definitely not for everyone; the main character is terrible and self-destructive, but I think you might appreciate it. Certainly resonated with me.

comments.author: Walter Sobchak
comments.text: She’s not bad looking. If she works on smiling she could do all right waiting tables instead of being the dish pig.

comments.author: Uncajo
comments.text: As Joey heard from the senile man that he walked by as the man was circling Lake Merrit for the tenth time in a row, “Life. What a concept.” Some of your comics can only be appreciated by a psychiatrist.
